Health: 3 assistant turns, avg cache_read per turn 8508, output 3307, context_pct ~0.059, score green. All three messages passed §2.2 strict validation on first try.

Conventions the steward drifted from cycle 9 but were not corrected (validator accepts both, undocumented in spec):
- gsl-steward-015 used to: "ALL" instead of "*" (BROADCAST recipient sigil)
- gsl-steward-015 used payload: { content: ... } instead of payload: { subject: ..., content: ... } (BROADCAST envelope)

Neither is a §2.2 violation; both are convention drift worth noting for a future "BROADCAST envelope conventions" spec note if it keeps recurring.

The rule worked exactly as intended on the first test: the steward applied the rule, reasoned out loud about which case applied (1 vs 2), made a defensible call, and produced clickable TRICKSTER asks.
